title: Check for the Mermaid renderer before building starts
lead:
A document with a Mermaid block fails with "Mermaid tooling missing" only
when `render` reaches its first diagram. By then Pandoc has already parsed
the document. With several targets (`quire a.md b.md`), the jobs are
rendered in order, so earlier outputs are written before a later document
fails.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** installing the renderer automatically; changing the
install hint or the `--no-mermaid` behavior; checking Pandoc or WeasyPrint
earlier.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The error already names the fix (`python3 install.py --with-mermaid`, or
`--no-mermaid`). It arrives late, and a multi-document build leaves a mix of
new and stale outputs. Checking once after planning and before any rendering
fails the whole call cleanly.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. When any planned job has a Mermaid block and the renderer is missing,
   the call fails before any job renders, and nothing is written.
2. The error is the same install hint as today and names the first source
   file that needs it.
3. With `--no-mermaid`, or with no Mermaid blocks, no check runs and a
   missing renderer is not an error.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Split the availability test out of `MermaidRenderer.__init__`
(`quire_mermaid.py:206-211`: `node` on PATH and
`node_modules/@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli/package.json`) into a function that
both the constructor and a preflight call. In `main`, after the duplicate
output check and before the render loop, run it once if any job without
`no_mermaid` contains a Mermaid fence (in its Markdown or included
sources). Detect fences from the source text so the check needs no Pandoc
run. A false positive only costs the hint. Do not start Node or the
browser in the preflight.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 test_quire.py`
- Real run with two targets, the second containing a Mermaid block, with the
  renderer hidden: confirm that neither output is written and report the
  message.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: No commit unless the owner asks.
